slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October vs 0.3% expected. Core prices, which exclude food and energy, rose 0.3% vs 0.2% expected. Stocks fell and Treasury yields rose.

slides.title: The Key Numbers
slides.subtitle: October CPI, monthly change (%)
slides.body: Seasonally adjusted. BLS did not publish most yearly rates because October 2025 data is missing.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.big: A bigger hike is now possible
slides.body: The Fed held at 3.75% to 4% on Oct 28. Traders now price a quarter-point hike in December as a near certainty, plus a 13.6% chance of a half-point move (CME FedWatch, Nov 10).

slides.title: What to Watch Next
items: Through Dec 8: Fed speakers on hike size.
